items.exampleEn: Please check in two hours before your flight.
items.exampleZh: 請在班機起飛前兩小時報到。

items.exampleEn: Guests must check out by noon.
items.exampleZh: 房客必須在中午前退房。

items.exampleEn: Come on! The bus is leaving.
My cousins came over last weekend.
items.exampleZh: 我的表兄弟姊妹上週末來我家。

items.exampleEn: We usually eat out on Friday nights.
items.exampleZh: 我們通常星期五晚上在外面吃飯。

items.exampleEn: The little boy fell down and started to cry.
items.exampleZh: 那個小男孩跌倒了，開始哭。

items.exampleEn: She filled in all the answers on the test.
items.exampleZh: 她在考卷上填好了所有答案。

items.sentenceEn: Be careful! You might fall down on the wet floor.
items.sentenceZh: 小心！你可能會在濕的地板上跌倒。

items.audioEn: We're going to eat out tonight because Mom is too tired to cook.
items.audioZh: 我們今晚要在外面吃飯，因為媽媽太累了，沒辦法煮飯。
items.questionZh: 他們今晚打算在哪裡吃晚餐？

items.sentenceEn: Why don't you come over for dinner on Sunday?
items.sentenceZh: 你星期天何不過來吃晚餐？

items.sentenceEn: Don't give up now. Come on!

items.stemEn: We ____ at the hotel and got our room key.
items.stemZh: 我們在飯店辦好入住，拿到了房間鑰匙。

items.stemEn: Please ____ the blanks with the words in the box.

items.passageEn: Last month, Ben's family stayed at a hotel by the sea. They checked in after lunch. The man at the front desk gave them a form, and Ben's dad filled it in. In the evening, they ate out at a seafood restaurant. Ben's little sister fell down on the beach, but she laughed and stood up quickly. The next morning, they checked out early. Back home, Ben's best friend came over to hear about the trip.
items.passageZh: 上個月，Ben 一家人住在海邊的一家飯店。他們吃完午餐後辦理入住。櫃台的人給他們一張表格，Ben 的爸爸把它填好。晚上，他們去一家海鮮餐廳吃飯。Ben 的妹妹在海灘上跌倒了，但她笑著很快站了起來。隔天早上，他們很早就退房了。回到家後，Ben 最好的朋友過來聽他說這趟旅行。

questions.questionZh: Ben 的妹妹在海灘上怎麼了？

items.promptZh: 我們明天早上十點會退房。
referenceEn: We will check out at ten tomorrow morning.
We're going to check out at ten tomorrow morning.
Tomorrow morning, we will check out at ten.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 check out 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 leave the hotel 等）也算對
明天的事用表示未來的寫法（例如 will check out、are going to check out、are checking out 等）
時間可放句首或句尾（例如 tomorrow morning at ten、at 10 a.m. tomorrow 等）

items.promptZh: 請把這張表格填好，然後交給我。
referenceEn: Please fill in this form and give it to me.
Please fill this form in and give it to me.
Please fill in this form, and then give it to me.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 fill in 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 fill out、complete this form 等）也算對
受詞可放在片語後面或中間（例如 fill in this form、fill this form in 等）
「交給我」可寫，例如 give it to me、hand it to me 等
